resources.string: Log your workouts and your meals. Every set and meal earns XP, and XP raises your level.
Today is your next workout. Log is everything you\'ve trained. Food is what you eat. You is your level, plans and settings.
The first time you open a screen, a short tip like this one shows how it works. Turn them back on any time in You.
This is the next day of your program. Tap Start; every set is saved as you go.
Workouts done this week, your streak of full weeks, and today\'s protein.
Want a different day? Tap it here to start it now.
Tap Do next to make that day your next workout and see its goals first. It lasts until you finish a workout.
Your protein so far and the next meal. Tap to open Food.
Limit break: lift the heavier weight the app suggests. Beat last time: more total weight than last session. Each pays bonus XP when you finish.
Tap − or + to change them, or tap a number to type it. They start from last time.
Logging saves the set and earns XP. The next set starts from these numbers.
Based on last session: go up, hold, or go lighter.
Opens a video search for this exercise.
Swipe for the next exercise. Everything is saved; tap Finish when you\'re done.
Tap a logged set to change it or delete it.
The ⋯ menu restarts the workout or stops it without saving.
Do one set of each exercise, then start the next round.
This logs the current set and moves on to the next exercise of the round.
Filled days are days you trained. Tap a day to see it or add a workout.
Add a workout to this day. It earns XP like a live one.
Change any finished workout, or delete it.
Copies the numbers from your previous session. An empty weight means bodyweight.
Your changes are kept only when you tap Save.
Tick a meal when you\'ve eaten it. Each one is +5 XP.
Ate something not on your plan? Log it here.
Add foods one by one with their amounts. They\'re saved as one meal.
Tap + for every glass. Reaching your water target is +10 XP.
Tick them when you take them. Each one is +2 XP.
Use the arrows or tap the date to fill in an earlier day.
See how you did over time.
Your meal library and your daily plans live here.
Plan, on the fly, or both
Change how you track food here or on the You tab.
Filled: within 10 % of your target. Faded: under it. Marked: over it.
Switch between protein, carbs, fat and the rest.
Tap any day to see what you logged.
Type a few letters, pick the food, then enter how much you ate.
What you ate before is one tap away. Tap a meal to add all its foods.
Done logs the whole meal for the day.
Switch the unit to whatever is easiest to count.
Create the food once. It\'s yours from then on and shows first.
Meals you deleted while a plan used them are kept here, and you can restore them.
Bring in meals from a file or your AI chat.
Logs this meal for today at one portion. Change the portion in Food.
A name and the macros for one portion are all you need.
Estimate them from the ingredients and their weights.
Search built-in foods, and online products when you\'re connected. Then enter the amount you use.
Fills the meal\'s macros. The ingredients themselves aren\'t saved.
Today and Food follow this plan. Only one is active at a time.
Duplicate a plan to try changes, or share it as text.
Paste a plan from your AI chat or open a file.
Give a meal a time to get a reminder before it.
Daily protein, water and calories. Hitting protein is +25 XP.
Share a program as text. A deleted built-in program can be restored.
Bring in a program you worked out with an AI chat.
Copy the prompt and paste it into the chat where you planned this.
Copy the chat\'s answer, then tap Paste.
Copy the error and send it back to the chat; it will fix the file.
Sets, meals and goals earn XP. Your stats grow with the sets that train them.
Change what Today and Food follow.
Switch between a meal plan, logging as you go, or both, and set your daily targets.
Choose which goals show, celebrate and remind you.
Three styles, five palettes, light or dark.
Save a backup file, for example to Google Drive, and load it on another phone.
